text: well my entire machine said kernel panic all over the monitor and was looping the audio of a video i was playing so idk this muyst have caused it
resolution: Diagnosed the kernel panic: an uncommitted change (req_0725/0728) raised MAX_RETAINED_VERTS to 8M verts = exactly 256 MiB, but g_retained_vbuf is ONE buffer that also carries the DYN_REGION tail (48 slots x 98304 verts = 144 MiB) on top, so its alloc requested ~400 MiB — over WebGPU's 256 MiB default maxBufferSize (we pass null limits at device creation in gpu.zig). In a validation build that aborts cleanly (the SIGABRT the user pasted); in a non-validation build the oversized per-frame GPU allocation hard-locks the driver -> kernel panic + looping audio. Fix in framework/gpu/3d.zig: MAX_RETAINED_VERTS now derives as MAX_BUFFER_VERTS - DYN_REGION_VERTS so intern+tail fill exactly the 256 MiB cap (112 MiB intern), introduced MAX_BUFFER_BYTES/VERTS naming the per-buffer API cap (not VRAM), and added a comptime assert that fails the BUILD instead of the machine if either constant is ever bumped past the cap. zig ast-check passes. Needs a full rebuild (framework change, not hot-reloadable). Uncommitted: the file also holds another lane's req_0725/0728 work, left for the user to commit.
